system.description:
Trigger: When you are targeted by an Attack Roll.

As a capricious plume of fire Sunborn can momentarily turn to flame, this effect lasts but a moment. When they are attacked with a weapon (swords, claws, arrows) they can make themselves immaterial, resulting in the attack dealing no damage.

When a DM declares an attack the player must declare their use of Flicker before seeing the result of the enemy's Attack Roll.
